name: Red Sea–Bab el-Mandeb Shipping Disruption
situation: Red Sea and global shipping disruption

definition.question: How severely is commercial shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and Red Sea disrupted?
definition.low_end: Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea are open with normal commercial traffic volumes, no attacks or credible blockade threats, and routine transit without special routing or naval escort.
definition.high_end: Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea are effectively closed to commercial shipping due to sustained attacks, enforced blockade, or mass avoidance with near-zero transits and prolonged Suez disruption.

readings.rationale: Houthis declared an immediate maritime embargo/naval blockade against Saudi Arabia at the relevant chokepoint with explicit escalation language, and Saudi coalition announced protection measures treating threats as piracy; Houthis have previously disrupted Red Sea shipping at scale, but implementation is unclear and no new attacks or traffic collapse are confirmed in evidence. Higher if verified…
